description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendments: Siddhamulla (south), Homagama D/S Division, Colombo District - Cad. Map No. 520020
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains specific amendments to land titles, including expunging particulars of a land parcel and correcting the name of a land owner for a specific property. The content focuses on land administration, property ownership records, and cadastral mapping details, which clearly falls under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
